newsitem.title: DENMARK: Christian Hansen signs pact with Schering.
newsitem.headline: Christian Hansen signs pact with Schering.

text.p: Danish medical and biotech group Christian Hansen Holding A/S said on Tuesday it entered an allergy product sales and distribution agreement with German pharmaceutical company Schering AG.

It said it would set up with Schering's wholly owned Scherax Arzneimittel GmbH a 50-50 owned company to be called ALK-Scherax Arzneimittel GmbH to sell and distribute allergy vaccines for Hansen's Alk Abello companies in Germany.
Hansen said the deal meant a minor positive adjustment to its previously announced forecast for a 10 percent increase in pre-tax profits for the full year 1996/97.
Hansen posted pre-tax profits of 251.2 million crowns in 1995/96.
